sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 1302 of 2023
Applicant :- Deepak
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Home Civil Lko.

And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Jayveer Rajput

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Jayveer Rajput, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Amit Kumar Dwivedi, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
298 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376, 504, 506 IPC & Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Makhi, District Unnao.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 28.10.2022 against the applicant and his four family members, alleging that the applicant had enticed away the informants minor daughter on 27.10.2022.
4.

In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she has stated that she is aged 18 years, she had gone with the applicant out of her own free will and she wants to live with the applicant only.

5. In the medico legal examination, the age of the victim has been opined to be 18 years.
Before the Magistrate also the victim stated that she loves the applicant, she had gone with him and she has married him.
She has categorically stated that the applicant has not enticed her away.

6. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
7. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the victim is major and she has consistently stated that she has gone with the applicant out of her own free will and she has married the applicant, coupled with the fact that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 11.12.2022 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

10. Let the applicant-Deepak be released on bail in Case Crime No. 298 of 2022, under Sections 363,
366, 376, 504, 506 IPC & Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Makhi, District Unnao on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
11. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
Order Date :- 22.5.2023 Pradeep/-
